title: Internal routing review
instruction: Confirm the responsible office and applicable disclosure authority before preparing an external handoff.

title: Assisted living notice
instruction: Use the official assisted living cover sheet and include the original notice. Verify the notice type and dates before sending.

title: Nursing facility transfer or discharge notice
instruction: Use the published nursing facility notice instructions and include the original notice.

title: Electronic monitoring
instruction: Verify whether the 14-day exception applies and use the corresponding consent form and submission instructions.

title: Long-term care intake
instruction: Confirm resident direction, the issue type, and the permitted contact or disclosure before contacting the office.

title: Supplement an existing OMHDD incident report
instruction: Verify the original case number and use OMHDD’s instructions for providing supplemental information.

title: Death or serious injury report
instruction: Use the official death or serious injury webform and capture the agency case number after filing.

title: Emergency manual restraint
instruction: Confirm which reporting requirements apply and use the approved reporting channel for the license holder.

title: Civil commitment support
channel: Civil Commitment Training and Resource Center
instruction: Use the published contact instructions for information, training, or advocacy.

title: OMHDD intake
instruction: Confirm the appropriate OMHDD intake route and the information authorized for disclosure.

title: Managed care state fair hearing review
channel: DHS Appeal to State Agency form
instruction: Confirm hearing status and applicable deadlines before preparing or supplementing an official request.

title: Health plan appeal
instruction: Use the appeal instructions on the health plan notice and confirm filing status, urgency, and continued benefits.

title: Managed care intake
instruction: Confirm program, plan, and issue type before using the published office contact instructions.
